jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Our client is an international association representing key stakeholders in the lobbying sector. They provide strategic support and advocacy at the EU level, fostering innovation and sustainable growth across the industry.

If you recognize yourself in this description, we look forward to meeting you and supporting your career path: we are at your service. At Unique, diversity and inclusion are values we prioritize. Here, you can excel in your individual

Jobomschrijving

Looking to join a dynamic and international work environment within the EU affairs sector in Brussels? We are seeking a versatile Office & IT Administrative Assistant to ensure smooth daily operations and provide high-level support to our professional teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity to learn and expand your skills in both office management and IT administration.

Responsibilities and Shared Tasks

Office Operations: Managing incoming mail (collection and distribution), handling office access badges, and liaising with external vendors to ensure a seamless workplace experience.

Administrative Support: Providing general support to various internal departments, including HR, Finance, and IT.

IT Inventory & Support: Maintaining the inventory of IT equipment (laptops, monitors, phones, printers) and offering basic administrative IT support to staff members.

Facilities & Catering: Preparing meeting rooms (checking equipment and supplies), coordinating catering orders with high-quality providers, and managing the maintenance of coffee machines and water dispensers.

Team Coordination: Acting as a bridge between internal teams and external service providers to ensure all office processes run efficiently.

Experience: Previous experience in office management, administration, or a similar support function.

Languages: Fluency in English is required; a good knowledge of French or Dutch is a strong asset.

IT Skills: Good command of standard office tools; a basic understanding of IT systems and hardware is a definite plus.

Organisational Skills: Capable of handling multiple responsibilities efficiently and meeting deadlines with a strong attention to detail.

Proactivity: A "can-do" mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and address issues before they arise.

Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with both internal stakeholders and external partners.

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

jobs.occupation: Business development manager DACH region - fixed contract
jobs.description:
Searching for a job in sales?Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?The company is Belgium based, but are you willing to travel extensively within the DACH region?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a business development manager who will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities across the German-speaking market (Dach region: Germany, Austria and Switzerland). You will play a pivotal role in expanding the company’s footprint, strengthening relationships with distributors in various markets.

• You will identify and pursue new business opportunities within the DACH region.
• Relationships with distributors and resellers will you build and maintain.
• For accounts in this region, you will serve as the primary point of contact.
• You will develop tailored solutions and proposals to meet specific customer needs.
• The market trends and competitor activities will you analyze to identify growth opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).
• Strong understanding of the DACH market and cultural nuances.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships.
• Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to drive decision-making.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM tools.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:
• Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
• Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
• Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
• Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
• Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
• Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

• You have initial experience as a renovation worker
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Sewer installation works
• Installing curbstones and edging
• Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
• Laying environmental pavement solutions
• Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
• Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
• Small to large-scale earthworks
 

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

• You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
• You have relevant experience in road construction;
• You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
• You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
• You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.
